label: KODAK VISION3 500T 5219/7219
source: Kodak technical data H-1-5219 (March 2026 edition), curves traced from the PDF's raster figures (pages 3-4)

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal of exposure in erg/cm2 for density 0.2 above D-min); curves end where the source plot ends them

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Eastman Kodak Company. Sensitometric plot header reads 'Exposure: 3200K Tungsten 1/50 sec; Process: ECN-2; Densitometry: ECN-2' (the 50D sheet says Status M; the 500T sensitometric header does not), while the spectral sensitivity header reads 'Densitometry: Status M'. Sensitometric x from the bottom Camera Stops ticks (-8..+8 at the plot edges, 35.4 px/stop); the top LOG EXPOSURE axis (-4.0..1.0 lux-s) spans the same width, i.e. 5.0 log units against 16 stops = 4.82 log units, so the two scales disagree by about 4%; the stop ticks were used and the stop labels -6, -5, -4, 7 and 8 are drawn up to 22 px left of their ticks. Sensitometric densities made non-decreasing (largest change 0.0000). Spectral sensitivity plot header reads 'Effective Exposure: 1/25 sec; Process: ECN-2; Densitometry: Status M; Density: 0.2>D-min'. Its y labels 0.0/1.0/2.0/3.0/4.0 sit centred on the plot floor and the gridlines (unlike the 50D sheet, where the labels are offset), so no axis shift was applied. None of the three curves reaches the floor: each ends where the source draws it (yellow-forming layer about 370-530 nm, magenta about 450-598 nm, cyan about 510-680 nm). Spectral sensitivity values are unsmoothed 1 nm samples of the trace (a moving average flattened the near-vertical curve ends); the last fraction of a nanometre of the steep magenta (598-599 nm) and yellow-layer (529-530 nm) drops falls between samples. Dye density plot header reads 'Process: ECN-2; D-mins subtracted'; minimum is the dashed Minimum Density curve as plotted (it ends at about 790 nm). Between about 743 and 773 nm the midscale neutral and cyan curves overlap within the line width; there they were placed from the line edges, not the merged stroke centre.

granularity.value: log10 diffuse RMS granularity (sigma D x 1, 48 um aperture)
granularity.note: Diffuse RMS granularity, same datasheet raster figure (header 'Process: ECN-2'); x shifted so the plot's green density curve equals the sensitometric green density at 0 stops (1.414), i.e. log relative exposure 2.422 is 0. Grain curves are dotted in the source; between about log E 0.85 and 1.5 (plot units) the green grain dots ride on the blue density line and were placed from the dots that clear it.

scan.note: fitted to 100 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871932805-kodak-vision3-500t/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
